about_the_game:
'Wonderdeck' is a card-based, top-down action deck-shooting roguelike game.

Players take on the role of Alice, the protagonist who has been stripped of her memories and soul, and embark on a journey to survive in the bizarre and dangerous world of Wonderdeck, created by the god of gaming, and get everything back.

The core of the game is the unique 'Deckloader' system.

Players acquire a variety of 'deckloader' weapons with different characteristics through the game.

Collect familiar cards such as Trump and Tarot and equip them in the slots of your deckloader.

When these cards complete a specific , the Deckloader goes beyond simple ability boosts and the attack method and behavior of the projectiles themselves change dramatically in real time.

Added to this is a flexible projectile system, which allows for a number of synergies, such as projectiles being guided, bouncing off walls, splitting, and even orbiting the player, depending on the combination of lineage and cards.

The biggest appeal of 'Wonderdeck' is discovering new deckloader and card combinations every time, completing your own powerful card combinations, and navigating unpredictable battles.

We hope you enjoy the fun of strategic choices and control at every moment in this unique world that combines Alice in Wonderland and death games.

How to operate

  • Aim: Move the mouse

  • Attack: Left mouse click

  • Overload (weapon-type ability): Right click

  • Movement: WASD

  • Roll: Space

  • Weapon Change: Tab

  • Reload: R

  • Weapon UI: C

    • Select weapons and cards: WASD or left mouse click

    • Replace Card: F

    • Remove card: long press F

    • Remove all cards: Hold R

    • View card combination information: Tab

    • Toggle Weapon Info/Collectibles Info UI: Q

  • Interaction: F

  • Exchange all cards including the current weapon and the weapon you want to acquire: hold F

  • Minimap: M

    • Move room: Left mouse click

    • Zoom in/out: Mouse wheel

short_description: A top-down shooter roguelike where your cards are your ammo. Build powerful hands with Poker and Tarot cards to unleash unique attacks in real-time. Master strategic deckbuilding and bullet-hell action. A new build, a new battle, every run.
